subject.title: fix(channels): progress drafts only for long tasks, with the model's own preamble as the status headline

question: Should progress-mode channels adopt the strict five-second gate and Discord/Telegram model-preamble headline as the default, including the three additive GetReplyOptions lifecycle fields?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it intentionally changes default user-visible behavior and expands a public plugin-facing contract; tests cannot determine whether that permanent product and compatibility direction is desired.

options.title: Approve after refreshed proof
